title: Surreal Green Alien Portrait
description: A green-skinned female figure with closed eyes and long white hair occupies the center, her face covered in alien symbols. She exhales a melting clock and purple smoke containing a small alien, while a crystal ball on a star base in front displays a white creature with a long tail against a backdrop of purple fields, a red celestial body with geometric patterns, and swirling black and white cosmic motifs.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork featuring a green-skinned female alien with closed eyes and long flowing white hair, her face adorned with glowing symbols, exhaling purple clouds and a melting clock. In the foreground a crystal ball on a geometric star base contains a small white alien creature. Background shows a purple lavender field under a large red celestial body with geometric triangles, swirling black and white cosmic patterns, small human figures on a path, and floating faces in the smoke, in a detailed psychedelic style with dripping effects.
